ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose generalization limits of learned protein and nucleic-acid models
ranked.summary: Explicit baselines and targeted out-of-domain tests now reveal where protein and DNA foundation models fail to generalize.

ranked.headline: Biological priors condition interpretable models across genomics and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Context-conditioned models are now being tested against claims that added biological data reliably improves prediction.

ranked.headline: Reference-constrained inference of latent structure in spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs spatial transcriptomics with scRNA-seq, multiome, and prior-knowledge references to constrain inference under ambiguity.

ranked.headline: Models partition chromatin, methylation and sequence inputs to predict gene regulation
ranked.summary: Large IHEC epigenome collections and paired single-cell multiomics now support explicit model-based partitioning of regulatory inputs.

ranked.headline: RNA sequence and modification profiling infers regulatory function across diverse systems
ranked.summary: Improved interaction calling, nanopore modification benchmarks, and foundation-model comparisons now sharpen inference of RNA regulatory function.

ranked.headline: Relational structure and learned embeddings drive single-cell dynamics and interventions
ranked.summary: Relational representations of spatial neighborhoods, regulatory networks and tissue graphs now extend to counterfactual and population scales.

ranked.headline: Atomistic simulation of ligand and peptide binding to disordered and designed targets
ranked.summary: Simulation now resolves conformational states and energetics beyond static poses for disordered regions and designed peptides.

ranked.headline: Hierarchical and expert-benchmarked classifiers refine immune cell annotation at scale
ranked.summary: Population-scale leukocyte atlases and independent cytometry benchmarks now test whether automated annotation holds up against expert labels.

ranked.headline: Reference pools and open software advance MS-based lipid and proteomic analysis
ranked.summary: Four June 2026 items pair reference-based annotation with standardized software for MS-based lipidomic, proteomic, and spatial omics data.

ranked.headline: Learned molecular representations and pretraining for drug property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark encoder choice, pretraining and multimodal fusion for ADME, drug-interaction and transporter prediction.

ranked.headline: Unified learned models predict PTM sites, peptide sequences, and cell-state responses
ranked.summary: Recent work applies contrastive, transformer, and knowledge-graph models to biomolecular prediction while scrutinizing evaluation protocols.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer single-cell lineage trees from CRISPR recording data
ranked.summary: Joint Bayesian inference of lineage trees and proliferation rates from CRISPR recordings is now implemented in software and benchmarked by simulation.

ranked.headline: Deep learning extracts ligands and enhanced density from cryo-EM maps with uncertainty
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add per-voxel uncertainty and low-resolution ligand detection to cryo-EM map analysis, alongside a PHENIX refinement workflow.

ranked.headline: New inference methods address bias and scale in genomic and microbiome data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce methods for bias correction, reference-free estimation, and scalable orthology and network inference.

ranked.headline: Predictive models steer iterative selection of drug combinations and small molecules
ranked.summary: Closed-loop designs now feed explicit QSAR, GNN surrogate and mechanistic ODE predictions back into candidate selection across recent preprints and papers.

ranked.headline: Population geometry and drift statistics are used to test neural circuit mechanisms
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test candidate mechanisms against population geometry, drift statistics, and habituation dynamics.

ranked.headline: Sequence-resolved measurement of base editing and Cas9 guide outcomes
ranked.summary: Sequence-resolved readouts now quantify base-editor off-target activity, mtDNA editing, and Cas9 guide functionality at scale.

ranked.headline: MD and structural mapping resolve conformational switches in transporters and enzymes
ranked.summary: Computational dissection of dynamics and interaction energetics now spans transporters, electron-transport complexes, arrestin, and salt-bridge families.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models link morphogen patterning, EGFR tumor initiation and epithelial rigidity
ranked.summary: Three June 2026 preprints pair spatially resolved simulations with reduced continuum models linking molecular kinetics, tissue mechanics and patterning.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design and metric choice reshape claims for biological foundation models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether sequence-based foundation models generalize across held-out chemistry, genomics, and off-target settings.

ranked.headline: Automated long-read and k-mer pipelines standardize microbial genome analysis
ranked.summary: Integrated long-read workflows and target-specific k-mer indices now pair automation with explicit memory, runtime, and coverage trade-offs.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings are being repurposed for taxonomic lineage prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language model representations are now being applied directly to lineage prediction and compressed for on-demand layer access.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods for integrating and validating heterogeneous omics and spatial data
ranked.summary: Batch correction can distort gene-gene correlations, so integrative omics methods need explicit checks on the structure downstream analyses depend on.

ranked.headline: Testing whether drug-response and binding predictors hold up on new datasets and cohorts
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and recalibration frameworks now test whether predictive models of drug response and binding transfer beyond their training data.

ranked.headline: Embeddings and domain-subgraph search accelerate prokaryotic orthology inference
ranked.summary: Scaling orthology inference now relies on learned representations and restricted search to avoid costly all-vs-all comparisons.

ranked.headline: Auditing Technical Artifacts in Single-Cell and Chromatin Accessibility Data
ranked.summary: Accessibility and expression analyses increasingly need auditable, sample-specific corrections for technical artifacts before inference.

ranked.headline: Linking missense variants to 3D protein structures across openly accessible resources
ranked.summary: Structure-aware missense resources now pair AlphaFold2 models, standardized functional labels, and pharmacogenetic mapping openly.

ranked.headline: Regulatory elements and annotations anchor genetic variation to trait architecture
ranked.summary: Enhancer, annotation, and structural-variant resolution now links genetic effects to explicit GWAS and trait-level anchors.

ranked.headline: Simulated observables as inference targets across coarse-grained and equilibrium models
ranked.summary: Physics-based simulators are now paired with learned surrogates and generative samplers to infer hidden parameters and predict experimental observability.

ranked.headline: Compact rule sets link developmental mechanisms to reproducible patterns and phenotypes
ranked.summary: Minimal parameterized and evolved developmental models now test how rules yield reproducible morphogenesis and phenotypic differences.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies extend genomic references across non-model eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Assembled references now reach insects, crustaceans, and Antarctic fishes, while sedaDNA benchmarks define rare-taxon detection limits for non-model taxa.

ranked.headline: Gene-level selection and horizontal transfer shape evolution across lineages
ranked.summary: Multi-scale comparative analyses now resolve evolutionary dynamics from single residues to viral metagenomes and eukaryotic proteomes.

ranked.headline: LLM agents paired with Bayesian and enrichment analysis for biological interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple LLM agents to pathway analysis, GO enrichment, and Bayesian scoring, with validation against historical data in one case.

ranked.headline: Platforms standardize metadata schemas to make biological data FAIR and reusable
ranked.summary: Multi-centre sequencing, consortium imaging and single-cell projects now generate data requiring harmonized, ontology-linked metadata for reuse.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer regulatory interactions from perturbation and expression data
ranked.summary: Models that predict unseen perturbation responses and infer regulatory connectivity now need explicit validation of inferred quantities.

ranked.headline: Cell-type connectivity and M-current shape network oscillations and synchrony
ranked.summary: Mean-field, spiking, and phase-model analyses now link interneuron connectivity and ionic currents to gamma, multistable, and synchronous network states.

ranked.headline: Duplication, transposons and rearrangements reshape eukaryotic genome evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies now link lineage-level genome change to specific structural mechanisms across plants, mammals and ants.

ranked.headline: NetCS reconstructs level-1 blobs in networks without all-quartet computation
ranked.summary: Fast consistent blob reconstruction and new distance metrics for ranked phylogenetic networks address scalable inference and comparison of network models.

ranked.headline: Ontology-linked and AI agent tools are automating omics data retrieval and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple knowledge graphs, federated queries, and LLM agents with standardized pipelines to make heterogeneous omics data findable.

ranked.headline: In silico and kinetic models probe keratin, ion channel, and muscle mechanics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now resolve unfolding forces, membrane-channel responses, and drug-specific contraction kinetics from simulation and tissue data.
